name: AI Validations
description: Adds AI-backed validation rules to the Field Validation module.
project_description: AI Validations plugs AI-powered validation rules into the contributed Field Validation module. Attach one of seven built-in rules to a text, image, or audio field, point it at an AI provider configured in AI Core, and the field value is passed or failed automatically when the entity is validated. The rules cover custom XTRUE/XFALSE prompt checks on text, images and audio transcripts, native provider moderation, text and image classification with confidence thresholds, and object detection with AND/OR keyword logic. Each rule is a field_validation FieldValidationRule plugin backed by a Symfony Validator constraint/validator pair, so the rules sit alongside your other validation rules in the same admin UI. It provides no routes, permissions, or config forms of its own; all provider/model selection is delegated to AI Core's ai_provider_configuration form element and credentials are handled by the AI module.
